summaries.evprimary: EV-Norm and EV-Raw jointly (same posts, folds and labels): one corpus for inference
summaries.all: value/ci95/ci95_units/mean: ratio of sums or mean over all units (weights corpora by noise magnitude and seed count; the primary corpus enters twice); equal_corpus_weights and mean_equal_corpus_weights: mean over the corpora evprimary and evpublic of the statistic computed within each (printed as pooled*)

config.bootstrap: per unit and split, B i.i.d. resamples of instances shared by all learners (paired), from rev_lib.fold_rng(seed, ds, fold, salt=5): validation indices first, then test
config.ci: ci95: percentile, two-stage bootstrap over units (folds with replacement within corpus, EV-Norm and EV-Raw sharing folds, then seeds with replacement within each drawn fold, one seed draw for both renderings when they have the same seeds); ci95_units: naive i.i.d. units

spread_to_noise.paper_definition: mean over units of the range of validation macro-F1 / mean over units of sqrt(mean_m F_m(1-F_m)/n_val), as in the paper
spread_to_noise.range_over_se_of_differences: mean range / mean sqrt(tr Sigma_d(paired) / (M-1)), the independence-equivalent SE of learner differences
spread_to_noise.binomial, paired: the same two ratios averaged per unit

config.oracle: oracle_common_lambda and oracle_noise_multiplier are chosen with test labels and are analysis-only quantities; estimator_lambda_ss_weighted weights each unit's lambda by ||d_val||^2 as the oracle implicitly does
config.kappa: lambda_u(kappa) = max(0, 1 - (M-3)/(M-1) * kappa * tr Sigma_d(val, paired) / ||d_val||^2); grid 0..8 step 0.01; kappa* minimises held-out deviation risk (pooled*: the mean over corpora of risk/raw)

pooling.equal_corpus_weights: mean over these corpora of the statistic computed within each
